chapter.ch1.title.context: Title of Chapter I. Canonical-hour names follow the termbase.

prologue.place.text: Kessendorf — the Hospice of Saint Ildra the Merciful
prologue.place.context: Place and time caption at the top-left of the scene.

prologue.001.text: The Free City of Kessendorf. Winter, in the ninth year of the Long Muster.
prologue.001.speaker: Narrator
prologue.001.context: Story scene "prologue" (Kessendorf — the Hospice of Saint Ildra the Merciful), line 1 of 10.

prologue.002.text: The river has frozen twice. The pyres outside the east gate have not gone out since autumn.
prologue.002.speaker: Narrator
prologue.002.context: Story scene "prologue" (Kessendorf — the Hospice of Saint Ildra the Merciful), line 2 of 10.

prologue.003.text: So. You are the new sawbones the Guild sent me. Kreuzer, is it?
prologue.003.speaker: Master Haller
prologue.003.context: Story scene "prologue" (Kessendorf — the Hospice of Saint Ildra the Merciful), line 3 of 10.

prologue.004.text: Apothecary-surgeon, sworn at Weissburg. I have my letters, Master Haller—
prologue.004.speaker: Dr. Kreuzer
prologue.004.context: Story scene "prologue" (Kessendorf — the Hospice of Saint Ildra the Merciful), line 4 of 10.

prologue.005.text: Letters. Letters don’t stop a man bleeding into the straw. Hands do. Show me your hands.
prologue.005.speaker: Master Haller
prologue.005.context: Story scene "prologue" (Kessendorf — the Hospice of Saint Ildra the Merciful), line 5 of 10.

prologue.006.text: …Steady enough. Sister! Our young doctor has arrived just in time for the Tuesday knife-fights.
prologue.006.speaker: Master Haller
prologue.006.context: Story scene "prologue" (Kessendorf — the Hospice of Saint Ildra the Merciful), line 6 of 10.

prologue.007.text: Sister Ilse, of the Merciful Order. I keep the instruments, the ledgers, and the Master’s temper.
prologue.007.speaker: Sister Ilse
prologue.007.context: Story scene "prologue" (Kessendorf — the Hospice of Saint Ildra the Merciful), line 7 of 10.

prologue.008.text: There’s a drover on the table already. Somebody at the Gilded Goose disagreed with his dice.
prologue.008.speaker: Sister Ilse
prologue.008.context: Story scene "prologue" (Kessendorf — the Hospice of Saint Ildra the Merciful), line 8 of 10.

prologue.009.text: Knife wounds. Simple work. Stitch him, drain him, salve him. I’ll watch.
prologue.009.speaker: Master Haller
prologue.009.context: Story scene "prologue" (Kessendorf — the Hospice of Saint Ildra the Merciful), line 9 of 10.

prologue.010.text: And Kreuzer — in this hospice we do not lose patients to simple work.
prologue.010.speaker: Master Haller
prologue.010.context: Story scene "prologue" (Kessendorf — the Hospice of Saint Ildra the Merciful), line 10 of 10.

op1-1.title.context: Operation title (briefing, HUD banner, results, theatre list).

op1-1.patient.context: Patient line on the chart and HUD.

op1-1.diagnosis.text: Knife wounds to the forearm and flank after a dice dispute. Moderate bleeding.
op1-1.diagnosis.context: Findings paragraph on the patient chart.

op1-1.p0.1.text: Two deep cuts. Take the gut thread and zig-zag across each wound to stitch it.
op1-1.p0.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-1.p0.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 3 of "A Tavern Knife" begins.

op1-1.p0.2.text: Cross the wound again and again, moving along it. One smooth stroke earns the best marks.
op1-1.p0.2.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-1.p0.2.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 3 of "A Tavern Knife" begins.

op1-1.p1.1.text: Blood’s pooling. Hold the leech-pipe over it to draw it off.
op1-1.p1.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-1.p1.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 3 of "A Tavern Knife" begins.

op1-1.p1.2.text: You can’t stitch through a pool of blood — drain first.
op1-1.p1.2.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-1.p1.2.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 3 of "A Tavern Knife" begins.

op1-1.p2.1.text: Just nicks left. Brush Saint’s Salve over the small ones — no need for thread.
op1-1.p2.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-1.p2.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 3 of 3 of "A Tavern Knife" begins.

s1-2.place.context: Place and time caption at the top-left of the scene.

s1-2.001.text: The drover lived. He paid in turnips and a promise not to gamble again. He will break it by Friday.
s1-2.001.speaker: Narrator
s1-2.001.context: Story scene "s1-2" (The Hospice — the next morning), line 1 of 6.

s1-2.002.text: Make way! Make way, damn you! Surgeon! Where’s the surgeon?
s1-2.002.speaker: Captain Mauer
s1-2.002.context: Story scene "s1-2" (The Hospice — the next morning), line 2 of 6.

s1-2.003.text: Captain Mauer of the Watch. Lower your voice, Captain, this is a house of mercy.
s1-2.003.speaker: Sister Ilse
s1-2.003.context: Story scene "s1-2" (The Hospice — the next morning), line 3 of 6.

s1-2.004.text: Horned raiders hit the timber-road caravan at dawn. We drove them off, but young Pieter took a shaft in the side.
s1-2.004.speaker: Captain Mauer
s1-2.004.context: Story scene "s1-2" (The Hospice — the next morning), line 4 of 6.

s1-2.005.text: Beast-folk fletch their arrows with barbed heads. Rip one straight out and you’ll tear half his side with it.
s1-2.005.speaker: Master Haller
s1-2.005.context: Story scene "s1-2" (The Hospice — the next morning), line 5 of 6.

s1-2.006.text: Nick the flesh at the entry with the lancet — twice — to free the barbs. Then pull. Cleanly.
s1-2.006.speaker: Master Haller
s1-2.006.context: Story scene "s1-2" (The Hospice — the next morning), line 6 of 6.

op1-2.title.context: Operation title (briefing, HUD banner, results, theatre list).

op1-2.patient.context: Patient line on the chart and HUD.

op1-2.diagnosis.text: Barbed arrow lodged in the left flank; crossbow bolt in the thigh. Raider ambush.
op1-2.diagnosis.context: Findings paragraph on the patient chart.

op1-2.p0.1.text: The arrow’s barbed. Lancet first — two nicks at the entry wound. Then seize it with the tongs and pull it well clear.
op1-2.p0.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-2.p0.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 2 of "The Barbed Shaft" begins.

op1-2.p0.2.text: Then drain and stitch the wound it leaves.
op1-2.p0.2.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-2.p0.2.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 2 of "The Barbed Shaft" begins.

op1-2.p1.1.text: The bolt in his thigh has no barbs. Tongs, and pull it straight out.
op1-2.p1.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-2.p1.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 2 of "The Barbed Shaft" begins.

op1-2.p1.2.text: Quick, clean pulls earn the best marks.
op1-2.p1.2.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-2.p1.2.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 2 of "The Barbed Shaft" begins.

s1-3.place.context: Place and time caption at the top-left of the scene.

s1-3.001.text: Pieter will keep his side, and his opinion of beast-folk.
s1-3.001.speaker: Narrator
s1-3.001.context: Story scene "s1-3" (The Hospice — noon), line 1 of 6.

s1-3.002.text: Doctor, the gunsmiths’ quarter. An apprentice was proving a new handgun barrel and it burst in his hands.
s1-3.002.speaker: Sister Ilse
s1-3.002.context: Story scene "s1-3" (The Hospice — noon), line 2 of 6.

s1-3.003.text: Burns across the chest and lead fragments driven under the skin.
s1-3.003.speaker: Sister Ilse
s1-3.003.context: Story scene "s1-3" (The Hospice — noon), line 3 of 6.

s1-3.004.text: Powder burns. The charred skin is dead — pluck the eschar away with tongs before you salve, or it festers.
s1-3.004.speaker: Master Haller
s1-3.004.context: Story scene "s1-3" (The Hospice — noon), line 4 of 6.

s1-3.005.text: The shot is in deep. You’ll have to open him. Trace the line I’ve inked, and keep your hand true.
s1-3.005.speaker: Master Haller
s1-3.005.context: Story scene "s1-3" (The Hospice — noon), line 5 of 6.

s1-3.006.text: He’s lost blood already. If his pulse flags, the tincture — hold it to the flesh and let it take.
s1-3.006.speaker: Master Haller
s1-3.006.context: Story scene "s1-3" (The Hospice — noon), line 6 of 6.

op1-3.title.context: Operation title (briefing, HUD banner, results, theatre list).

op1-3.patient.context: Patient line on the chart and HUD.

op1-3.diagnosis.text: Burst-barrel injury: powder burns across the chest, lead fragments embedded beneath the skin.
op1-3.diagnosis.context: Findings paragraph on the patient chart.

op1-3.p0.1.text: His pulse is weak already. Hold the tincture to the flesh to steady him if you need it.
op1-3.p0.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-3.p0.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 4 of "Powder Burns" begins.

op1-3.p0.2.text: Burns first. Pluck the black eschar away with the tongs, then salve the raw flesh.
op1-3.p0.2.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-3.p0.2.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 4 of "Powder Burns" begins.

op1-3.p1.1.text: Now open him along the inked line with the lancet. Keep to the line — start at the glowing end.
op1-3.p1.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-3.p1.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 4 of "Powder Burns" begins.

op1-3.p2.1.text: There — the shot. Pull each ball out with the tongs.
op1-3.p2.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-3.p2.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 3 of 4 of "Powder Burns" begins.

op1-3.p3.1.text: Everything’s clear. Close the incision with the thread.
op1-3.p3.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-3.p3.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 4 of 4 of "Powder Burns" begins.

s1-4.place.context: Place and time caption at the top-left of the scene.

s1-4.001.text: Word travels fast in Kessendorf. By dusk, there is a queue at the hospice door.
s1-4.001.speaker: Narrator
s1-4.001.context: Story scene "s1-4" (The Hospice — dusk), line 1 of 7.

s1-4.002.text: Doctor… this one was found in the Tanners’ Rows. Swellings at the neck and groin. Fever. Maggots in a sore.
s1-4.002.speaker: Sister Ilse
s1-4.002.context: Story scene "s1-4" (The Hospice — dusk), line 2 of 7.

s1-4.003.text: Buboes. Lance them before they burst, draw off the pus, and salve the wound. Rot-patches creep back if you dawdle.
s1-4.003.speaker: Master Haller
s1-4.003.context: Story scene "s1-4" (The Hospice — dusk), line 3 of 7.

s1-4.004.text: And the grubs — the cautery brand. Hold it on them until they stop wriggling. Mind you don’t sear good flesh.
s1-4.004.speaker: Master Haller
s1-4.004.context: Story scene "s1-4" (The Hospice — dusk), line 4 of 7.

s1-4.005.text: A plague case. In the city. How very interesting.
s1-4.005.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s1-4.005.context: Story scene "s1-4" (The Hospice — dusk), line 5 of 7.

s1-4.006.speaker: Sister Ilse
s1-4.006.context: Story scene "s1-4" (The Hospice — dusk), line 6 of 7.

s1-4.007.text: Please, do carry on, Doctor. I only wish to watch. Pestilence so often has a sponsor.
s1-4.007.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s1-4.007.context: Story scene "s1-4" (The Hospice — dusk), line 7 of 7.

op1-4.title.context: Operation title (briefing, HUD banner, results, theatre list).

op1-4.patient.context: Patient line on the chart and HUD.

op1-4.diagnosis.text: Plague buboes, spreading rot and an infested sore. High fever.
op1-4.diagnosis.context: Findings paragraph on the patient chart.

op1-4.p0.1.text: Lance each bubo with a single touch of the lancet before it bursts. Then drain the pus and salve it.
op1-4.p0.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-4.p0.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 3 of "Pestilent Humours" begins.

op1-4.p1.1.text: Grubs in the sore! The cautery brand — hold it on each one until it stops moving.
op1-4.p1.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-4.p1.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 3 of "Pestilent Humours" begins.

op1-4.p1.2.text: Don’t linger on bare flesh with the brand.
op1-4.p1.2.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-4.p1.2.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 3 of "Pestilent Humours" begins.

op1-4.p2.1.text: The rot’s spreading. Salve every patch — quickly, it creeps back.
op1-4.p2.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-4.p2.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 3 of 3 of "Pestilent Humours" begins.

s1-5.place.context: Place and time caption at the top-left of the scene.

s1-5.001.text: Near midnight a carriage without a crest stops at the gate. A page-boy is carried in, raving.
s1-5.001.speaker: Narrator
s1-5.001.context: Story scene "s1-5" (The Hospice — the small hours), line 1 of 8.

s1-5.002.text: The choir… they’re singing in me… make them stop singing…
s1-5.002.speaker: Page-boy Emmerich
s1-5.002.context: Story scene "s1-5" (The Hospice — the small hours), line 2 of 8.

s1-5.003.text: Doctor, look at his chest. Those marks — they’re moving.
s1-5.003.speaker: Sister Ilse
s1-5.003.context: Story scene "s1-5" (The Hospice — the small hours), line 3 of 8.

s1-5.004.text: …That is no disease. Those are sigils. Someone has written on this boy.
s1-5.004.speaker: Master Haller
s1-5.004.context: Story scene "s1-5" (The Hospice — the small hours), line 4 of 8.

s1-5.005.text: Kreuzer. Listen to me carefully. Sear the sigils out with the brand — trace every stroke.
s1-5.005.speaker: Master Haller
s1-5.005.context: Story scene "s1-5" (The Hospice — the small hours), line 5 of 8.

s1-5.006.text: And if something… answers… when you do — there is an old apothecary’s rite. The Litany of Stillness.
s1-5.006.speaker: Master Haller
s1-5.006.context: Story scene "s1-5" (The Hospice — the small hours), line 6 of 8.

s1-5.007.text: Trace the five-pointed star and still your heart. For a few breaths, the world will wait for you.
s1-5.007.speaker: Master Haller
s1-5.007.context: Story scene "s1-5" (The Hospice — the small hours), line 7 of 8.

s1-5.008.text: Do not do it where the Inquisitor can see. The Tribunal does not distinguish between a prayer and a spell.
s1-5.008.speaker: Master Haller
s1-5.008.context: Story scene "s1-5" (The Hospice — the small hours), line 8 of 8.

op1-5.title.context: Operation title (briefing, HUD banner, results, theatre list).

op1-5.patient.context: Patient line on the chart and HUD.

op1-5.diagnosis.text: Unknown. Moving marks on the chest. Delirium. “The choir is singing in me.”
op1-5.diagnosis.context: Findings paragraph on the patient chart.

op1-5.p0.1.text: Those sigils are draining him. Trace every stroke of each one with the brand to sear it out.
op1-5.p0.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-5.p0.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 5 of "The Hour of Matins" begins.

op1-5.p1.1.text: Something is moving beneath the skin. We have to open him. The lancet — along the line.
op1-5.p1.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-5.p1.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 5 of "The Hour of Matins" begins.

op1-5.p2.1.text: Saints preserve us… what is that?
op1-5.p2.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-5.p2.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 3 of 5 of "The Hour of Matins" begins.

op1-5.p2.2.text: Doctor — if ever there were a time for the Litany, it is now. Draw the star with the right hand.
op1-5.p2.2.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-5.p2.2.context: Assistant callout when phase 3 of 5 of "The Hour of Matins" begins.

op1-5.p3.1.text: It’s gone. Tend the wounds it left.
op1-5.p3.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-5.p3.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 4 of 5 of "The Hour of Matins" begins.

op1-5.p4.1.text: Everything’s clear. Close the incision with the thread.
op1-5.p4.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op1-5.p4.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 5 of 5 of "The Hour of Matins" begins.

s1-end.place.context: Place and time caption at the top-left of the scene.

s1-end.001.text: The thing in the boy’s chest came apart like wet ash. The boy sleeps. He no longer hears singing.
s1-end.001.speaker: Narrator
s1-end.001.context: Story scene "s1-end" (The Hospice — before dawn), line 1 of 10.

s1-end.002.text: Doctor… after it broke, a word was left seared into the flesh. Matins.
s1-end.002.speaker: Sister Ilse
s1-end.002.context: Story scene "s1-end" (The Hospice — before dawn), line 2 of 10.

s1-end.003.text: The first of the canonical hours. The first prayer of the night.
s1-end.003.speaker: Master Haller
s1-end.003.context: Story scene "s1-end" (The Hospice — before dawn), line 3 of 10.

s1-end.004.text: A curse that lives and fights like a beast, and signs itself like a psalm. A Malison.
s1-end.004.speaker: Master Haller
s1-end.004.context: Story scene "s1-end" (The Hospice — before dawn), line 4 of 10.

s1-end.005.text: And if this was Matins… then somewhere, someone is already writing Lauds.
s1-end.005.speaker: Master Haller
s1-end.005.context: Story scene "s1-end" (The Hospice — before dawn), line 5 of 10.

s1-end.006.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s1-end.006.context: Story scene "s1-end" (The Hospice — before dawn), line 6 of 10.

s1-end.007.text: Tell me — at the end, your hands moved so very quickly. Almost as if time itself were… obliging you.
s1-end.007.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s1-end.007.context: Story scene "s1-end" (The Hospice — before dawn), line 7 of 10.

s1-end.008.text: Practice, Inquisitor. And the grace of Saint Ildra.
s1-end.008.speaker: Dr. Kreuzer
s1-end.008.context: Story scene "s1-end" (The Hospice — before dawn), line 8 of 10.

s1-end.009.text: Of course. The grace of the Saint. I shall pray on it.
s1-end.009.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s1-end.009.context: Story scene "s1-end" (The Hospice — before dawn), line 9 of 10.

s1-end.010.text: END OF CHAPTER I — THE HOUR OF MATINS
s1-end.010.speaker: Narrator
s1-end.010.context: Story scene "s1-end" (The Hospice — before dawn), line 10 of 10.

chapter.ch2.title.context: Title of Chapter II. Canonical-hour names follow the termbase.

s2-1.place.text: The Timber Road — the Watch’s muster camp, three leagues east of Kessendorf
s2-1.place.context: Place and time caption at the top-left of the scene.

s2-1.001.text: CHAPTER II — THE HOUR OF LAUDS
s2-1.001.speaker: Narrator
s2-1.001.context: Story scene "s2-1" (The Timber Road — the Watch’s muster camp, three leagues east of Kessendorf), line 1 of 8.

s2-1.002.text: A week after the page-boy, a writ arrives with the Watch’s seal: the hospice’s surgeon is requisitioned for the muster.
s2-1.002.speaker: Narrator
s2-1.002.context: Story scene "s2-1" (The Timber Road — the Watch’s muster camp, three leagues east of Kessendorf), line 2 of 8.

s2-1.003.text: Don’t look at me like that, Doctor. I didn’t ask for you. The Inquisitor “suggested” it to the Burgomaster.
s2-1.003.speaker: Captain Mauer
s2-1.003.context: Story scene "s2-1" (The Timber Road — the Watch’s muster camp, three leagues east of Kessendorf), line 3 of 8.

s2-1.004.text: So he can watch you somewhere with fewer witnesses.
s2-1.004.speaker: Sister Ilse
s2-1.004.context: Story scene "s2-1" (The Timber Road — the Watch’s muster camp, three leagues east of Kessendorf), line 4 of 8.

s2-1.005.text: We’re clearing the Grauwald of raiders before the spring caravans. My lads need a surgeon more than a city needs rumours.
s2-1.005.speaker: Captain Mauer
s2-1.005.context: Story scene "s2-1" (The Timber Road — the Watch’s muster camp, three leagues east of Kessendorf), line 5 of 8.

s2-1.006.text: Speaking of which — the scouts came back. Two of them. Something followed them out of the barrow-fields.
s2-1.006.speaker: Captain Mauer
s2-1.006.context: Story scene "s2-1" (The Timber Road — the Watch’s muster camp, three leagues east of Kessendorf), line 6 of 8.

s2-1.007.text: Doctor, it’s a gravehound bite. Claw rakes across the back, and — look — it left its teeth in him.
s2-1.007.speaker: Sister Ilse
s2-1.007.context: Story scene "s2-1" (The Timber Road — the Watch’s muster camp, three leagues east of Kessendorf), line 7 of 8.

s2-1.008.text: Corpse-eaters carry a venom in their spit. Hold the tincture to the bite itself and it will draw the poison.
s2-1.008.speaker: Sister Ilse
s2-1.008.context: Story scene "s2-1" (The Timber Road — the Watch’s muster camp, three leagues east of Kessendorf), line 8 of 8.

op2-1.title.context: Operation title (briefing, HUD banner, results, theatre list).

op2-1.patient.context: Patient line on the chart and HUD.

op2-1.diagnosis.text: Mauled by a corpse-eating hound. Claw rakes across the back, fangs lodged in the shoulder, venom spreading from the bite.
op2-1.diagnosis.context: Findings paragraph on the patient chart.

op2-1.p0.1.text: The venom first — hold the tincture on the bite until it takes.
op2-1.p0.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-1.p0.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 3 of "Gravehound" begins.

op2-1.p0.2.text: The longer it spreads, the harder it drags on him.
op2-1.p0.2.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-1.p0.2.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 3 of "Gravehound" begins.

op2-1.p1.1.text: Now the fangs. Tongs — pull each one clear.
op2-1.p1.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-1.p1.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 3 of "Gravehound" begins.

op2-1.p2.1.text: Claw rakes. Three deep lines — drain and stitch each.
op2-1.p2.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-1.p2.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 3 of 3 of "Gravehound" begins.

s2-2.place.context: Place and time caption at the top-left of the scene.

s2-2.001.text: The scout will limp, but he will limp home.
s2-2.001.speaker: Narrator
s2-2.001.context: Story scene "s2-2" (The muster camp — afternoon), line 1 of 7.

s2-2.002.text: Put me down, you long-legged oafs! I can walk! I can… mostly walk.
s2-2.002.speaker: Orsa Flintvein
s2-2.002.context: Story scene "s2-2" (The muster camp — afternoon), line 2 of 7.

s2-2.003.text: Dwarf prospector. Her crew was working a seam in the hills when it caved in.
s2-2.003.speaker: Captain Mauer
s2-2.003.context: Story scene "s2-2" (The muster camp — afternoon), line 3 of 7.

s2-2.004.text: The rock went black, Doctor. Black and wrong, like a bruise in the stone. It sang when we struck it. Then it burst.
s2-2.004.speaker: Orsa Flintvein
s2-2.004.context: Story scene "s2-2" (The muster camp — afternoon), line 4 of 7.

s2-2.005.text: There are shards under her skin that I can’t see — but the flesh around them is spoiling.
s2-2.005.speaker: Sister Ilse
s2-2.005.context: Story scene "s2-2" (The muster camp — afternoon), line 5 of 7.

s2-2.006.text: Master Haller sent this with me. His old Scrying Lens. Pass it slowly over the flesh and it shows what hides beneath.
s2-2.006.speaker: Sister Ilse
s2-2.006.context: Story scene "s2-2" (The muster camp — afternoon), line 6 of 7.

s2-2.007.text: Dwarf hide’s thicker than yours, lad. You’ll want a strong arm on that thread.
s2-2.007.speaker: Orsa Flintvein
s2-2.007.context: Story scene "s2-2" (The muster camp — afternoon), line 7 of 7.

op2-2.title.context: Operation title (briefing, HUD banner, results, theatre list).

op2-2.patient.context: Patient line on the chart and HUD.

op2-2.diagnosis.text: Cave-in at a hexstone seam. Shards driven beneath the skin, invisible to the eye. Surrounding flesh spoiling.
op2-2.diagnosis.context: Findings paragraph on the patient chart.

op2-2.p0.1.text: Rock splinters on the surface first. Tongs.
op2-2.p0.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-2.p0.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 3 of "The Black Seam" begins.

op2-2.p1.1.text: Now — the Scrying Lens. Pass it slowly over the flesh; where something hides, it shimmers.
op2-2.p1.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-2.p1.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 3 of "The Black Seam" begins.

op2-2.p1.2.text: Hold it still over the shimmer to bring the shard to light, then pull it.
op2-2.p1.2.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-2.p1.2.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 3 of "The Black Seam" begins.

op2-2.p2.1.text: Clean up the spoiled flesh and any wounds left.
op2-2.p2.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-2.p2.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 3 of 3 of "The Black Seam" begins.

s2-3.place.context: Place and time caption at the top-left of the scene.

s2-3.001.text: Orsa sleeps in the supply wagon, snoring like a bellows. She has promised to name a mine after the Doctor. It will probably be a bad one.
s2-3.001.speaker: Narrator
s2-3.001.context: Story scene "s2-3" (The muster camp — night), line 1 of 4.

s2-3.002.text: Forager. Went to check his snares near the old web-trees. We found him wrapped up like a Martinmas ham.
s2-3.002.speaker: Captain Mauer
s2-3.002.context: Story scene "s2-3" (The muster camp — night), line 2 of 4.

s2-3.003.text: A web-spinner bite. Venom, spreading fast. And these lumps under the skin… Saints. She laid in him.
s2-3.003.speaker: Sister Ilse
s2-3.003.context: Story scene "s2-3" (The muster camp — night), line 3 of 4.

s2-3.004.text: Lance the sacs before they hatch, Doctor, and sear what spills out. If they hatch on their own, they’ll scatter.
s2-3.004.speaker: Sister Ilse
s2-3.004.context: Story scene "s2-3" (The muster camp — night), line 4 of 4.

op2-3.title.context: Operation title (briefing, HUD banner, results, theatre list).

op2-3.patient.context: Patient line on the chart and HUD.

op2-3.diagnosis.text: Web-spinner bite. Neurotoxic venom spreading from the neck; several egg sacs laid beneath the skin.
op2-3.diagnosis.context: Findings paragraph on the patient chart.

op2-3.p0.1.text: Venom from two bites. Tincture on each, quickly.
op2-3.p0.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-3.p0.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 3 of "Brood-Mother’s Kiss" begins.

op2-3.p1.1.text: The sacs — lance each one with a single touch, then sear the hatchlings with the brand.
op2-3.p1.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-3.p1.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 3 of "Brood-Mother’s Kiss" begins.

op2-3.p1.2.text: Mind the ones that are close to hatching.
op2-3.p1.2.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-3.p1.2.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 3 of "Brood-Mother’s Kiss" begins.

op2-3.p2.1.text: One more sac, deeper. Use the lens to find it, then open it.
op2-3.p2.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-3.p2.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 3 of 3 of "Brood-Mother’s Kiss" begins.

op2-3.p2.2.text: And he’s taken a fever-bubo from the bite — lance and cleanse it.
op2-3.p2.2.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-3.p2.2.context: Assistant callout when phase 3 of 3 of "Brood-Mother’s Kiss" begins.

s2-4.place.context: Place and time caption at the top-left of the scene.

s2-4.001.text: Doctor. I have brought you a gift.
s2-4.001.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s2-4.001.context: Story scene "s2-4" (The muster camp — before midnight), line 1 of 7.

s2-4.002.text: Two of the Inquisitor’s men drag a thin, grey-robed figure into the light. His chest is a lattice of glowing sigils.
s2-4.002.speaker: Narrator
s2-4.002.context: Story scene "s2-4" (The muster camp — before midnight), line 2 of 7.

s2-4.003.text: A lay-cantor of the Hollow Choir. We took him in the barrow-fields, singing to the dead.
s2-4.003.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s2-4.003.context: Story scene "s2-4" (The muster camp — before midnight), line 3 of 7.

s2-4.004.text: The moment he began to confess, those marks ignited. His masters would rather he burned than spoke.
s2-4.004.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s2-4.004.context: Story scene "s2-4" (The muster camp — before midnight), line 4 of 7.

s2-4.005.text: He also swallowed something. You will keep him alive. I have questions, and the dead are poor at answering them.
s2-4.005.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s2-4.005.context: Story scene "s2-4" (The muster camp — before midnight), line 5 of 7.

s2-4.006.text: …Doctor. Whatever he is, he’s a patient.
s2-4.006.speaker: Sister Ilse
s2-4.006.context: Story scene "s2-4" (The muster camp — before midnight), line 6 of 7.

s2-4.007.speaker: Dr. Kreuzer
s2-4.007.context: Story scene "s2-4" (The muster camp — before midnight), line 7 of 7.

op2-4.title.context: Operation title (briefing, HUD banner, results, theatre list).

op2-4.patient.text: A lay-cantor of the Hollow Choir
op2-4.patient.context: Patient line on the chart and HUD.

op2-4.diagnosis.text: Silence-sigils igniting across the chest (hexfire). Self-administered poison. Prisoner of the Ash Tribunal.
op2-4.diagnosis.context: Findings paragraph on the patient chart.

op2-4.p0.1.text: The poison he swallowed — tincture, now, or he’s gone before we start.
op2-4.p0.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-4.p0.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 4 of "The Silenced Cantor" begins.

op2-4.p1.1.text: Those sigils are burning him from within. Sear each one out — every stroke.
op2-4.p1.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-4.p1.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 4 of "The Silenced Cantor" begins.

op2-4.p2.1.text: The hexfire burns. Pluck the eschar, then salve them.
op2-4.p2.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-4.p2.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 3 of 4 of "The Silenced Cantor" begins.

op2-4.p3.1.text: Maggots in an old sore — the Tribunal’s cells are filthy. Brand them.
op2-4.p3.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-4.p3.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 4 of 4 of "The Silenced Cantor" begins.

s2-5.place.context: Place and time caption at the top-left of the scene.

s2-5.001.text: The cantor lived long enough to whisper one thing, before Stroh’s men took him away.
s2-5.001.speaker: Narrator
s2-5.001.context: Story scene "s2-5" (The muster camp — dawn), line 1 of 6.

s2-5.002.text: Lauds… is sung at dawn… with the muster… under the banner…
s2-5.002.speaker: The cantor
s2-5.002.context: Story scene "s2-5" (The muster camp — dawn), line 2 of 6.

s2-5.003.text: The dawn muster? That’s now — the whole company’s singing the morning hymn—
s2-5.003.speaker: Captain Mauer
s2-5.003.context: Story scene "s2-5" (The muster camp — dawn), line 3 of 6.

s2-5.004.text: Across the camp, the hymn falters. The standard-bearer drops to his knees, the banner falling across him.
s2-5.004.speaker: Narrator
s2-5.004.context: Story scene "s2-5" (The muster camp — dawn), line 4 of 6.

s2-5.005.text: Doctor! It’s Jorg, the standard-bearer — his chest is moving… it’s singing back!
s2-5.005.speaker: Sister Ilse
s2-5.005.context: Story scene "s2-5" (The muster camp — dawn), line 5 of 6.

s2-5.006.text: Clear a table. Sister — every instrument we have.
s2-5.006.speaker: Dr. Kreuzer
s2-5.006.context: Story scene "s2-5" (The muster camp — dawn), line 6 of 6.

op2-5.title.context: Operation title (briefing, HUD banner, results, theatre list).

op2-5.patient.context: Patient line on the chart and HUD.

op2-5.diagnosis.text: Collapsed during the dawn hymn. Something beneath the sternum is singing.
op2-5.diagnosis.context: Findings paragraph on the patient chart.

op2-5.p0.1.text: We have to open him — along the line, Doctor.
op2-5.p0.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-5.p0.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 1 of 4 of "The Hour of Lauds" begins.

op2-5.p1.1.text: Saints… it has a choir. Those little lights are its Voices — hold the brand on each as it circles.
op2-5.p1.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-5.p1.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 4 of "The Hour of Lauds" begins.

op2-5.p1.2.text: Silence all of them and its heart will be bare.
op2-5.p1.2.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-5.p1.2.context: Assistant callout when phase 2 of 4 of "The Hour of Lauds" begins.

op2-5.p2.1.text: It’s done. Tend what it left of him.
op2-5.p2.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-5.p2.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 3 of 4 of "The Hour of Lauds" begins.

op2-5.p3.1.text: Close him up. Gently — he has a banner to carry.
op2-5.p3.1.speaker: Sister Ilse
op2-5.p3.1.context: Assistant callout when phase 4 of 4 of "The Hour of Lauds" begins.

s2-end.place.context: Place and time caption at the top-left of the scene.

s2-end.001.text: The singing stops. The standard-bearer breathes. In the flesh over his heart, a single word: LAUDS.
s2-end.001.speaker: Narrator
s2-end.001.context: Story scene "s2-end" (The muster camp — morning), line 1 of 9.

s2-end.002.text: Two of them now. Matins in the city, Lauds in my own camp. Someone is keeping time, Doctor.
s2-end.002.speaker: Captain Mauer
s2-end.002.context: Story scene "s2-end" (The muster camp — morning), line 2 of 9.

s2-end.003.text: Six more hours to the full Office. Prime. Terce. Sext. None. Vespers. Compline.
s2-end.003.speaker: Sister Ilse
s2-end.003.context: Story scene "s2-end" (The muster camp — morning), line 3 of 9.

s2-end.004.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s2-end.004.context: Story scene "s2-end" (The muster camp — morning), line 4 of 9.

s2-end.005.text: When that thing screamed, every candle in this tent stopped flickering. The flames stood still. For eight heartbeats.
s2-end.005.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s2-end.005.context: Story scene "s2-end" (The muster camp — morning), line 5 of 9.

s2-end.006.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s2-end.006.context: Story scene "s2-end" (The muster camp — morning), line 6 of 9.

s2-end.007.text: …The morning air is very still, Inquisitor.
s2-end.007.speaker: Dr. Kreuzer
s2-end.007.context: Story scene "s2-end" (The muster camp — morning), line 7 of 9.

s2-end.008.text: So it is. We will speak at length, you and I. After Prime.
s2-end.008.speaker: Inquisitor Stroh
s2-end.008.context: Story scene "s2-end" (The muster camp — morning), line 8 of 9.

s2-end.009.text: END OF CHAPTER II — THE HOUR OF LAUDS
s2-end.009.speaker: Narrator
s2-end.009.context: Story scene "s2-end" (The muster camp — morning), line 9 of 9.

bark.flooded.text: Too much blood — draw it off with the leech-pipe before you stitch!
bark.flooded.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.hexstone.text: The hexstone is corrupting the flesh around it — get it out!
bark.hexstone.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.barbs.text: Barbed! Nick the flesh at the entry with the lancet before you pull.
bark.barbs.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.burn-salve.text: The dead flesh is off. Now salve the raw burn.
bark.burn-salve.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.burn-eschar.text: Pluck away the charred eschar with the tongs first!
bark.burn-eschar.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.pus.text: Draw off the pus before you salve it.
bark.pus.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds.the_choir_is_silenced.text: The choir is silenced — its heart is bare! Brand it, now!
bark.lauds.the_choir_is_silenced.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds-hymn.text: It’s singing — every verse tears him open! Stitch the cuts as they come!
bark.lauds-hymn.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds-shielded.text: The Voices shield it. Silence them first — hold the brand on each as it circles.
bark.lauds-shielded.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds.its_gone_under_the.text: It’s gone under the skin! The Scrying Lens — hunt it down!
bark.lauds.its_gone_under_the.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds.it_shattered_hexstone_everywh.text: It shattered — hexstone, everywhere! Get every shard out before it spoils him!
bark.lauds.it_shattered_hexstone_everywh.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.eggsac-lanced.text: Spiderlings! Brand them before they scatter!
bark.eggsac-lanced.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.malison-open.text: Its shroud has parted — sear it with the brand, now!
bark.malison-open.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.malison-rend.text: It’s tearing the flesh as it moves! Stitch those wounds!
bark.malison-rend.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.malison-veiled.text: The brand can’t touch it while it’s veiled. Wait for the shroud to part!
bark.malison-veiled.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.malison.its_shedding_hexlings_burn.text: It’s shedding hexlings! Burn them before they feed!
bark.malison.its_shedding_hexlings_burn.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.malison.its_splitting_apart_seize.text: It’s splitting apart! Seize every shard with the tongs and cast it out — before they rejoin!
bark.malison.its_splitting_apart_seize.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.brand-flesh.text: Careful! The brand is searing healthy flesh!
bark.brand-flesh.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.low-vitals.text: Vitals are failing! Use the tincture, Doctor!
bark.low-vitals.speaker: Sister Ilse
